problem: Fourteen rendering, layout, field-calculation, mail-merge and related runtime rows still lacked current evidence reviews. Saved field/chart/media values and bounded data edits do not establish an application renderer, field engine, mail-merge runtime or playback service.
changes: Add two evidence-only native operations tests: visual-mode refusal parity over the complete 139-file corpus, and worksheet-evaluator refusal over nine native Word field/mail-merge inputs.

Verify capabilities and actual string/JSON/sink view APIs agree, including explicit locked-file precedence, supported password unlocks and unsupported encrypted XLSB ingress. A refusing sink records any attempted output and must receive no write call.

Record fourteen explicit supported/unsupported contracts with current API checks and additional native owner evidence. Keep these reviews separate from positive semantic coverage and missing native specimens. Update all eight format matrices and the corpus review-set guard.

verification_scope.all_formats_and_variants: Every manifest fixture is opened through file-backed Auto and byte-backed Eager ingress, including DOC/DOCX/RTF/XLS/XLSX/XLSB/PPT/PPTX, template/macro/slideshow variants and both extensionless embedded children. There are 278 source opens, of which fourteen are locked. All input files are reread unchanged.
verification_scope.visual_modes: HTML, SVG, screenshot and PDF each return the capability-advertised typed error through File::view, File::view_json and File::view_to. The mode appears in unprotected error messages. No sink write is attempted. The 278 source handles plus twelve supported unlocked handles yield 1160 mode checks and 3480 public view-call refusals.
verification_scope.encrypted_scope: Locked reads return DocumentProtected with the exact password-required capability reason. DOC/DOCX use the recorded Office42! fixture password; other fixtures use OfficeFixture42!. Twelve password-backed unlocks then refuse visual output with UnsupportedCapability. Both encrypted XLSB unlock attempts retain the exact unsupported-decryption message. This test never publishes decrypted output or claims newly added XLSB decryption support.
verification_scope.source_preservation: For unencrypted handles, complete publication bytes before and after refused requests are equal. Every original on-disk fixture remains byte-identical. This compares publication across the requests and does not infer new native application serialization behavior.
verification_scope.word_field_boundary: Native mail-merge, math/navigation and layout-extension DOC/DOCX/RTF files exercise both ingress modes. Their Evaluate capability explicitly states that the format has no worksheets. Evaluate and recalculate both return UnsupportedCapability, preserving text and complete publication bytes. This is a check of the public worksheet-evaluator boundary, not a claim that a Word-field execution endpoint exists.
verification_scope.rtf_projection: RTF field results have separate story owners and intentionally do not enter ordinary paragraph text. MATCH_009 is asserted in the stored IF field inventory; DOC/DOCX expose it in their saved text projection. The test preserves that distinction instead of treating missing paragraph-text expansion as field loss.
verification_scope.owner_evidence: Selected native tests additionally qualify DOC FIB/Dop2013 saved counters and merge metadata; DOCX SEQ caption caches, mail-merge settings CRUD and chart-hole preservation; RTF PAGE/merge caches; XLS chart-cache edits; XLSX chart/companion preservation; XLSB inert chart graphs after cell edits; PPT media frame/preview payloads and timing-duration edits; and PPTX chart/media package preservation. These remain concrete data profiles, not runtime/rendering claims.
verification_scope.limits: No production behavior changed. No native application rendering, pagination, shaping, field evaluation, mail-merge generation, slideshow/media playback, browser/resource activation, macro execution or certificate trust is claimed. No positive semantic credit is added to any excluded-runtime row.
